$comment: Executable PR claims (Reality Control). Every claim names living evidence; scripts/detect-contradictions.mjs verifies the refs exist on disk and blocks any claim without them — an unevidenced claim is an IMPLEMENTATION CLAIM, NOT VERIFIED.

claims.assertion: Capability records carry independent codeState/operationalState/exposure; operational states advance only with evidence; exposure production/limited_autonomy requires live verification; expired verification regresses loudly.

A PR body carrying a do-not-merge clause without an explicit merge-intent acknowledgment is blocked; claims without living evidence are blocked; sub-live capabilities described as live-verified are blocked. No model judgment involved.

One replayable harness drives evidence -> tournament -> genome -> visual world -> policy -> reservations -> service enqueue -> persisted payload -> publish-denial under kill switch -> audit trail, with deterministic mocks and zero provider calls.
